PK = primary key; UK = unique key; FK = foreign key.
= NOT NULL; unmarked columns allow NULL.
Child endpoint: 0..* = many; 0..1 = at most one via a unique key.
All non-tenant references include tenant_id to prevent cross-tenant links.
All FKs: ON DELETE NO ACTION / ON UPDATE NO ACTION; deferrable.
External entities are reference stubs, not additional logical tables.
